task: Stage automatic local Claude subscription review verification for SDK while preserving existing merge gates.

criteria.description: Add a metadata-only GitHub workflow for signed local Claude reviews, using an immutable REV checkout and Node 24. Handle PR changes, signed dispatches, CI lifecycle, main updates and scheduled expiry. Never check out or execute the PR revision with the check-writing token. Read only the public verification key from repository variables; no Claude credential is stored in Actions.

Configure every ordinary SDK PR CI job as required for local approval, including typecheck, lint, tests, coverage, ESM, landing, audit and changeset. Keep the existing CI workflow and REV gate unchanged during staging; do not claim this PR completes live validation or required-check cutover.

Document automatic serial reviews, subscription use, manual operation, immutable upstream implementation and deferred live validation. Map every changed file to this actual rollout request, include relevant source and observed tests, and test workflow privilege boundaries and required CI configuration. No application or release payload changes.
